name: NanoClaw
description: Runs a personal assistant agent on the Claude Agent SDK in per-agent Docker containers, reachable from WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and other chat apps, with scheduled tasks.

skills.name: Multi-Channel Messaging
skills.description: Connects agents to WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Teams, iMessage, Matrix, email, and more, added on demand with /add- skills.

skills.name: Container Isolation
skills.description: Runs each agent group in its own Linux container with its own CLAUDE.md, memory, and only the filesystem mounts you allow.

skills.name: Scheduled Tasks
skills.description: Runs recurring jobs such as weekday briefings, with optional script gates that skip waking the agent when there is no work to do.

skills.name: Credential Gateway
skills.description: Routes outbound requests through a gateway that injects credentials at request time, so agents never hold raw API keys.
